Move Better, Feel Better

(Quick Desk Stretches)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Even good posture gets stiff if you hold it all day. Today's video walks you through four quick stretches you can do right at your desk, no gym gear needed.

Today's 4 stretches

1. Chest opener
Opens up the front of your shoulders after hours hunched over a keyboard.
2. Chin tucks
Gently draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. Great for neck tension from screen time.
3. Hip flexor stretch
Releases the front of your hips, which tighten up when you sit for long periods.
4. Thoracic rotation, 5 each side
One hand behind your head, sit tall and rotate through your upper back.
